name: Satsukibe Ayane
source:
She was raised as a rich girl, and while she seems reliable, she is a little naive.
She is a good mother who raises her lover, Tsukiya, as if he were her own child. After
her husband, who was her son-in-law, passed away, she is depressed, but she doesn't show it on the surface, and acts strong and is considerate of everyone.
Although she is a widow, she still thinks of her husband and has never taken off her ring.
Both of her parents have passed away.

"I wonder what your day was like today? Can you tell me, mother?"
